Etihad Rail connects Dubai and Abu Dhabi with new station

The Al Yalayis station on the Etihad Rail network is set to open on September 30, connecting Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The new route is expected to reduce travel time between the two emirates to 57 minutes. Details regarding fares, the route, and booking information are expected to be released. The opening of this station is part of the broader Etihad Rail project aimed at developing the UAE's railway infrastructure.
